title: Cooking smoke control during an outage
summary: A boundary for emergency cooking when power is out and people are tempted to use unsafe flames, grills, stoves, or fuel indoors.
content: Core sequence: 1) Use only cooking methods intended for the location and keep combustion devices outside sleeping air. 2) Choose cold shelf-stable food when ventilation, fuel, or supervision is uncertain. 3) Keep children, loose clothes, paper, bedding, and fuel away from the cooking area. 4) Stop cooking if smoke, dizziness, headache, flame spread, or arguments over placement begin.
